title: roldana mezquitalana
intro: Roldana mezquitalana, commonly known as the "Mexican Sage", is a flowering plant in the sunflower family that is native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Roldana mezquitalana include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve muscle spasms, reduce pain, and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Roldana mezquitalana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
